identifiers.identifier_scope: Actinium Ac 225 Zadavotide Guraxetan is identified by its investigational code 225Ac-FAPI-XT.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: Actinium Ac 225 Zadavotide Guraxetan is a radiopharmaceutical that targets fibroblast activation protein (FAP) on cancer-associated fibroblasts, delivering targeted radiation to the tumor microenvironment.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: The agent binds to fibroblast activation protein (FAP) and delivers alpha radiation from Actinium-225 to induce DNA damage in nearby cancer cells.

data_notes.record_scope: This record is focused on the investigational radiopharmaceutical Actinium Ac 225 Zadavotide Guraxetan, also known as 225Ac-FAPI-XT.
